districtNote: 2017 figures are given only for districts that existed under the same name in December 2017, for Folkestone and Hythe (Shepway in 2017) and for Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole (the three former districts combined). Districts created by later reorganisations show no 2017 figure.

notes: HMRC Table 1a. Individuals rounded to the nearest 50; values to the nearest £1,000.
Charged withdrawals are what HMRC calls unauthorised withdrawals; HMRC does not say how many were for a first home over the price cap rather than for any other reason.
HMRC notes that the withdrawal charge was 25% in every year except 2020/21, when it was reduced to 20%.
Figures for 2017/18, the first year of the scheme, are no longer reported.

launch.text: The Lifetime ISA was announced at Budget 2016 and became available in April 2017.
